sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Lint rule setup
sections.what: Sets up the linter with the standard Next.js rules and tells it to skip the build output and installed package folders.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the checks standard for a Next.js project and avoids checking generated files.
sections.watch_out: If a folder that holds real source code is added to the ignore list, its problems will not be reported.

summary: Sets the code checking rules for the project, using the standard Next.js rules and ignoring build output and installed packages.
purpose: Lets the linter (a tool that flags likely mistakes and style problems) check the project consistently.
why: Likely reason: the project is built with Next.js, so it uses the framework's standard rules.
how: Imports the base Next.js rule set and the core web performance rules, adds an ignore list for the build folder and installed packages, and exports the combined list.
inputs: The project's source files when the linter runs.
risks: No custom project rules are added, so project-specific mistakes are not caught. Ignoring the wrong folder could hide real problems.
debug: If lint reports errors in unexpected files, check the ignore list. If lint will not start, check that the eslint and Next.js lint packages are installed.
